subject: On-prem edge enclave addition for renewal: sequencing & timelines
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@medinovo.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: IT <it@medinovo.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Expansion at renewal - two isolated on-prem enclaves (Frankfurt + Dublin)

Diego,

Quick note as we start planning for our July renewal window: MediNovo is committed to expanding our Private footprint and needs two fully isolated on-prem enclaves (Frankfurt and Dublin) to support new EU data residency and regulatory segmentation. High-level asks:
- Separate VPCs with no cross-tenant data paths; hardware will be provided at each site.
- Dedicated clusters per enclave (expected initial capacity: 4 GPUs/site, burst to 8)
- Support for HSM/KMS integration and airgapped install option for Frankfurt.
- Target go-live: 2027-07-01 for Frankfurt, 2027-08-01 for Dublin (can be staggered).

Could you outline what Redwood needs to turn this into an amendment at renewal (term changes, provisioning lead times, pricing bands)? I've attached a short spec with expected node counts.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Platform Engineering
MediNovo Health

Attachment: medinovo_expansion_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet - site specs)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@medinovo.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Expansion at renewal - two isolated on-prem enclaves (Frankfurt + Dublin)

Alex — thanks for the clear spec. Looping in Laura and Priyom for commercial and contractual processing.

Summary of what we can do and immediate asks from our side:
1) Product/ops approach
   - Create two new Private environments (FRK-edge, DUB-edge) scoped as isolated tenants.
   - Provision dedicated cluster templates: baseline 4x A100-equivalent GPUs (per site), autoscale to 8 during peak.
   - HSM/KMS integrations supported; airgapped install option requires our on-site installer and a weekend maintenance window.

2) Timeline and sequencing
   - Discovery & SOW sign-off: 2 weeks after PO.
   - Provisioning for first site (Frankfurt): 4-6 weeks after asset validation.
   - Second site (Dublin) can be queued; expected additional 3 weeks on top of FRK.

3) Commercial framing for renewal amendment
   - We can add an addendum to your renewal: term extension options (12 vs 24 months) with tiered committed capacity pricing.
   - One-time provisioning fee for on-prem install + monthly recurring for committed capacity.

Can you confirm: preferred term length, whether you want us to include 24-month committed pricing, and preferred installation weekend(s)? If you can issue a PO draft, we'll attach a Redwood order form and a suggested SOW.

Attachments: redwood_order_form_v2.pdf (order form - stub)

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Proposal summary (to go in order form + SOW):
- One-time provisioning fee: EUR 45,000 (covers on-site engineer, airgap install support, SOW validation).
- Committed monthly capacity (per site): Baseline 4 GPUs -> EUR 12,000/month/site; burst to 8 billed at overage rate.

- Term options: 12 vs 24 months; 24-month receives an additional 10% off committed capacity pricing.
- Payment terms: net 30.

Priyom — can you confirm whether we can approve 22% for strategic customers (MediNovo likely qualifies given ARR / roadmap)? If not, I'll prepare the 20% offer and an optional 24-month 30% delta pricing scenario to present.

Diego — I'll draft SOW (outline attached) and update redwood_order_form_v2.pdf with the numbers above. Maria at procurement asked for SOC2 scope; I'll attach the compliance pack when I send to them.

Thanks,

Account Executive, Redwood Inference
